import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] xx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] yy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int sx, sy;
    static int[][] v = new int[N][N];

    static class Ban {
        int x, y;
        Ban(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int[][] d, int sx, int sy) {
        boolean[][] c = new boolean[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<Ban> q = new LinkedList<>();
        c[sx][sy] = true;
        d[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new Ban(sx, sy));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Ban t = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int hx = t.x + xx[i];
                int hy = t.y + yy[i];
                if (hx >= 0 && hx < n && hy >= 0 && hy < n && !c[hx][hy] && a[hx][hy] >= '0' && a[hx][hy] <= '9') {
                    c[hx][hy] = true;
                    d[hx][hy] = d[t.x][t.y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Ban(hx, hy));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][][][] dp = new boolean[N * 6][N][N][N][N];
    static boolean[][][][] u = new boolean[N][N][N][N];

    static int[][] g = new int[2 * N * N][2 * N * N];
    static int[] p = new int[2 * N * N];
    static boolean[] c = new boolean[2 * N * N];

    static boolean bfs1() {
        Arrays.fill(c, false);
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        c[0] = true;
        q.offer(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            if (x == 2 * n * n + 1)
                return true;
            for (int h = 0; h <= 2 * n * n + 1; h++) {
                if (g[x][h] != 0) {
                    if (!c[h]) {
                        c[h] = true;
                        p[h] = x;
                        q.offer(h);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }
        sx = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        sy = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        int[][] dist = new int[N][N];
        bfs(dist, sx, sy);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] >= '0' && a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int yt = 0; yt < t; yt++) {
            for (int sx_ = 0; sx_ < n; sx_++) {
                for (int sy_ = 0; sy_ < n; sy_++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (!dp[yt][sx_][sy_][x][y]) continue;
                            if (dist[x][y] <= yt) continue;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                                int hx = x + xx[i];
                                int hy = y + yy[i];
                                if (hx >= 0 && hx < n && hy >= 0 && hy < n && a[hx][hy] >= '0' && a[hx][hy] <= '9') {
                                    if (dist[hx][hy] >= yt + 1)
                                        dp[yt + 1][sx_][sy_][hx][hy] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int yt = 0; yt <= t; yt++) {
            for (int sx_ = 0; sx_ < n; sx_++) {
                for (int sy_ = 0; sy_ < n; sy_++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (dp[yt][sx_][sy_][x][y]) {
                                u[sx_][sy_][x][y] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; x1++) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; y1++) {
                if (a[x1][y1] >= '0' && a[x1][y1] <= '9')
                    g[0][x1 * n + y1 + 1] = a[x1][y1] - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; x2++) {
            for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; y2++) {
                if (b[x2][y2] >= '0' && b[x2][y2] <= '9')
                    g[n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1][2 * n * n + 1] = b[x2][y2] - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; x1++) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; y1++) {
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; x2++) {
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; y2++) {
                        if (!(a[x1][y1] >= '0' && a[x1][y1] <= '9')) continue;
                        if (!(a[x2][y2] >= '0' && a[x2][y2] <= '9')) continue;
                        if (!u[x1][y1][x2][y2]) continue;
                        g[x1 * n + y1 + 1][n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        while (bfs1()) {
            int minu = INF;
            for (int i = 2 * n * n + 1; i != 0; i = p[i]) {
                minu = Math.min(minu, g[p[i]][i]);
            }
            for (int i = 2 * n * n + 1; i != 0; i = p[i]) {
                g[p[i]][i] -= minu;
                g[i][p[i]] += minu;
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * n * n + 1; i++) {
            ans += g[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
